intro.fr: I Was A Teenage Exocolonist se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: I Was A Teenage Exocolonist can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Northway Games sort I Was A Teenage Exocolonist en 2022.
text.en: Northway Games releases I Was A Teenage Exocolonist in 2022.

text.fr: Création du dépôt GitHub pamymaf/Exocolonist-AP, qui héberge l'APWorld de I Was A Teenage Exocolonist.
text.en: The GitHub repository pamymaf/Exocolonist-AP, home of the I Was A Teenage Exocolonist APWorld, is created.

text.fr: Publication de la première version, v0.1.0 (préversion).
text.en: The first version, v0.1.0 (pre-release), is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version v1.1, la plus récente au 21 octobre 2026 (9 versions publiées).
text.en: Version v1.1 is released, the latest as of October 21, 2026 (9 versions released).

text.fr: I Was A Teenage Exocolonist figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: I Was A Teenage Exocolonist is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
